summary: Annovis Bio filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 7,895,000 common shares and warrants to purchase up to 7,105,500 shares, each unit priced at $1.90. The warrants have a $2.25 exercise price and a six-year term. The offering is underwritten by Canaccord Genuity, with proceeds of ~$14.0M before expenses. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC merger, or abrupt management change. The filing simply reflects ordinary equity issuance to raise funds for operations.
